title.en: An Act to Re-enact Republic Act Six Hundred and Thirteen, Known as the Export Control to Amend Sections Four and Five Thereof

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1952/ra_825_1952.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Secretary of Education is hereby authorized to convert, organize and maintain the Camarines Sur Trade School as a National School of Arts and Trades, of the type of the Philippine School of Arts and Trades, to be known as the Camarines Sur National School of Arts, and Trades.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos for its conversion, operation and maintenance during its first year is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any fund in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated. Thereafter, the yearly appropriation for this School shall be included in the Annual General Appropriation Acts.

Upon the approval of this Act the Province of Camarines Sur shall at once transfer to the National Government, free of charge, the present school site, buildings, machineries, hand-tools, books, materials, shop equipment, etc., belonging to the Camarines Sur Trade School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 14, 1952.
